name: Hotel Zinc
detail: The location is good and the cleanliness of the accommodation is also okay. I especially appreciated that you sent several addresses for free public parking that can be used when the parking lot is full! The front desk staff who checked me in were very kind and I was pleased! I recommend it!

name: Hotel Fine Jeju
detail: Located at the center of Seogwipo City, it was convenient to move east and west, and there were several parking lots nearby, making parking easy. The breakfast was delicious, especially the porridge, bulgogi, and spicy pork. The staff greeted us with smiles in the morning as well. The room condition was also good. It was suitable for three people in a two-bed room, and towels were changed daily. I think I will use it again next time.

name: HOTEL NANTA JEJU
detail: I stayed overnight on a business trip to Ara Shin City. There was a room with a view of the sea and mountains, but I stayed in a room overlooking the Nanta performance hall and the adjacent park, which wasn't bad either. In the morning, I was very satisfied with the hotel because I could take a walk along a beautiful path while enjoying the view of the mountains and the sea. The bedding and bed were also comfortable. I had left my ID behind, but they contacted me before I went to the airport, so I was able to stop by again. Thank you.
area: Halla Mountain National Park,Jeju - View on map

name: Shilla stay Jeju Airport
detail: The hotel is in a great location, right on the Baojian Road pedestrian street, surrounded by countless beauty shops, clothing stores, souvenir shops, and various delicious restaurants. There is a bus stop right under the hotel that provides access to the airport and major attractions, and free parking is available for guests who drive. Although the decor is somewhat dated, the cleanliness and professional service of the staff make up for it, especially the bedding in the rooms, which is particularly comfortable, and the bathroom amenities are also very moisturizing. Overall, this is the most highly recommended, cost-effective hotel in the city center.

name: Hotel Bridge Seogwipo
detail: One of the best choices I made during my 4-night, 5-day trip to Jeju was staying at the Seogwipo Bridge Hotel. Since it was a long trip, I couldn't ignore accommodation costs, and it's not easy to find a place with this level of condition at a reasonable price. Thanks to the neatly arranged bedding and the comfortable room condition without any unpleasant odors, it received a passing score from the very first impression. The ocean view was also the best!! Throughout the trip, it was more than sufficient to relieve fatigue, and due to the staff's kind and warm responses, I felt good both when leaving and returning to the hotel. I will use it again for my next trip to Jeju ^^

name: LOTTE CITY HOTEL JEJU AIRPORT
detail: The room condition was good, and the bedding was soft. The location was in the city center, making transportation convenient, and guests could take a free bus to the airport. The staff at the room maid service, pool, and lobby desk were very friendly. If you go in the summer, I recommend going to the pool around sunset to evening because the sunlight is strong during the day. I recommend only requesting the hotel breakfast on the morning of check-out. The view is nice, but the taste is not great. It might be better not to request it unless you have a busy morning where you can't stop by other places on your way to the airport.

name: Shinshin Hotel Seogwipo
detail: I don’t usually write reviews, but during my trip to Jeju Island, I had such a great experience at this hotel that I want to share my thoughts, especially considering it was the most affordable option. # Pros 1. The room and bathroom were incredibly clean. 2. The room was spacious. 3. The bed was large and had just the right amount of cushioning. 4. The pillows were not too high and were comfortable. 5. I’m sensitive to noise, but it was very quiet, so I had a great sleep without being disturbed, even by minor sounds like the refrigerator. 6. The breakfast was good value for the price. 7. The staff was friendly. 8. The Olle Market was nearby, making it convenient for food and walks. 9. The price was exceptionally low. Compared to the 5-star hotel in Jeju City I stayed at the night before, this was about a third of the price and was much better. 10. The upscale hotel I stayed in the previous night had a musty smell, but this place didn’t have any unpleasant odors. 11. Disposable tea was provided. 12. If I visit Jeju again, I will definitely choose Shin Shin Hotel Seogwipo instead of a luxury hotel. I sincerely thank the hotel staff. # Slight drawbacks - Parking must be done in front of Shin Shin Hotel Ocean. You can exit from the basement level. However, it wasn't a major inconvenience.

name: Shinshin Hotel Cheonjiyeon
detail: This is the hotel I booked during my trip to Jeju Island. The hotel is modern, neat, and I was able to relax well in a quiet environment. There's a bus stop right in front, so transportation is convenient, and above all, the accommodation cost is affordable. I think I will use it again on my next visit to Jeju Island.

name: Urbanstay Jeju Airport
detail: There was no smell of cigarettes, and it was pleasant. (However, there was a strange herbal smell like medicine in the hallway?? I don't know what it was, but I passed by quickly without breathing.) I found it very convenient to have a washing machine since I was staying long, and the table was spacious, making it easy to eat takeout. Also, there were many bus stops nearby, which made it convenient to get around. The bathroom might be a bit small for men. The luggage storage was convenient and safe, and I used it well before check-in and after check-out. However, I didn't know how to get water and towels, so I bought water and used the towels I had with me for washing. 😭

name: Lofy house
detail: The sea view seems to be the best choice, especially if you're not looking for hotel-level quality. (At least for me) I booked it with the mindset that it just needed to be a clean place while traveling alone on foot. I was very satisfied as the bathroom in the room was clean and spacious. It's also a big plus that there's a bus stop and a supermarket nearby, so I didn't have to walk far... hehe I booked it solo, but the owner was very kind and even upgraded my room since I was staying for a long time! I plan to book it every time I come to Jeju~~
